note: Third-sector (järjestö) talking support — the peer-community rung. This is NOT the crisis path: any safety flag bypasses this rung entirely and goes to Kriisipuhelin 09 2525 0111 / 112 (invariant 8). Hours below were checked against the live source on 2026-09-08; where a source could not be read, the entry carries the honest 'check the site' fallback rather than an invented hour. No service is added here without clinician review.

entries.note: The default rung-2 entry. Verified 2026-09-08: run by MIELI ry, dozens of organisations operate on the platform, registration required but conversation is fully anonymous. Some Swedish and English content exists but the platform is primarily Finnish.

Formerly Solmussa-chat. Verified 2026-09-08: staffed by trained volunteers who complete crisis-support training, debriefed by MIELI crisis workers after every shift. Source states evenings Monday–Thursday but not exact times, so the hours string says so rather than inventing them.

NOT CLINICIAN-REVIEWED. MIELI's English support, and the only English-language MIELI service there is: MIELI confirmed on 21.9.2026 (email, Susanna Winter) that every other-language crisis PHONE line is closed permanently. This is appointment-based and is NOT a crisis line, which is why it is here and not in config/crisis.json. Verified 2026-09-21 on tukinet.fi/fi/palvelut/support-in-english: 'Crisis support via chat or email for English speakers living in Finland', 'This support is free of charge', anonymous registration on Tukinet required, chat booked at least 30 minutes ahead, email answered by a 'crisis professional or a trained volunteer from MIELI or our member organizations', and 'Response times for English messages may be longer'. The `url` points at MIELI's English support page rather than the Tukinet booking page because that is the page MIELI maintains; Tukinet's English page is the booking step behind it and is the same service, so it is NOT listed a second time (D-25).

Hours verified 2026-09-08 against mieli.fi/sv: Mon and Wed 16–20, Tue/Thu/Fri 9–13. Staffed by crisis-work professionals, students in the field, and volunteers. This number also appears in config/crisis.json as the Swedish crisis line — the crisis path is unchanged; this entry is the non-crisis listing of the same service.

TWO CORRECTIONS to the V2 brief, both verified 2026-09-08 at arligttalat.fi. (1) It is a CHAT ONLY — there is no Ärligt talat Swedish-language crisis phone line; the Swedish crisis phone is MIELI's Kristelefonen, listed separately. (2) It is staffed by LICENSED PROFESSIONALS (psychologists, counsellors, sexual-health and eating-disorder specialists), not trained volunteers, and it is for ages 13–29, not adults generally. Needs clinician confirmation.

entries.operator: MIELI Suomen Mielenterveys ry and partners
entries.note: The youth entry, also used by the C4 youth handoff. Hours verified 2026-09-08 via partner organisations (sekasin.fi blocks automated fetches): Mon–Fri 9–24, Sat–Sun 15–24, ages 12–29, staffed by organisation professionals and trained volunteers. Swedish at sekasin.fi/sv/.

The peer-with-lived-experience option. Verified 2026-09-08: expert mental-health advice weekdays 12–15, and volunteers who have themselves experienced mental-health problems on Wednesday and Thursday evenings 18–20. Monthly group chat on the first Tuesday, 18–19:30. whoAnswers is 'mixed' because both are true depending on when you go — the hours string says which is which.

NOT CLINICIAN-REVIEWED. Added on the product owner's instruction (D-21), not on our judgement. Verified 2026-09-18 on the church's own page, evl.fi/apua-ja-tukea/kirkon-keskusteluapu/ (kirkonkeskusteluapua.fi 301s there): 'Palveleva puhelin toimii numerossa: 0400 221 180 (avoinna joka päivä klo 18-24)', chat 'ma-pe klo 16-20', callers' numbers 'eivät välity päivystäjille', answered by 'vaitiolovelvollisia koulutettuja vapaaehtoisia ja kirkon työntekijöitä'. Parish pages still say the line runs to 01, and to 03 on Fridays and Saturdays; the church's own page wins. The service is free but the number is an ordinary mobile number and the operator charges the call ('pvm/mpm'), which the cost note says plainly. No age range is stated, so none is applied. Finnish only: the Swedish Kyrkans samtalstjänst is a separate page and is not added. `sector` is third-sector for ordering purposes; the church is a public-law body, not an NGO, and a reviewer may want that distinction.

NOT CLINICIAN-REVIEWED. Added on the product owner's instruction (D-22), not on our judgement. Verified 2026-09-18 on nyyti.fi. Nyyti's page: 'The course and its materials are available to everyone free of charge', 'about from two to two and half hours', 'you can do it in several parts', opened in a browser with no sign-up mentioned, hence `anonymous`. Open to everyone, so no `audienceRef`. English only: the site has fi/sv language switches but no Finnish or Swedish version of the course itself could be confirmed. Nyyti's other courses (the eco-crisis course, Learn Life Skills on hyvakysymys.fi) and its tests are not added.

NOT CLINICIAN-REVIEWED. Added on the product owner's instruction (D-22), not on our judgement. Verified 2026-09-18 on nyyti.fi. Groups page (fi): 'Kaikki täysi-ikäiset opiskelijat ennakkoilmoittautumisen kautta', 'Ryhmät ovat maksuttomia', Swedish groups offered ('Voit osallistua ruotsinkielisiin ... ryhmiin'); English page lists English groups. Some groups are narrower: Toivo mielessä and Jännän äärellä are for higher-education students, MiehenTila for men in higher education. `whoAnswers: professional` rests on the Toivo mielessä page ('Ryhmän ohjaajana toimii Nyytin työntekijä'); the other groups' pages were not each checked, so a reviewer should confirm it holds for all. Registration and named participation, hence `registration-required`. Online (Zoom or Teams depending on the group). NyytiCoaching was NOT added: Nyyti describes it as career-direction coaching for students near the end of their studies, not mental-health support (D-22).

FALLBACK ONLY, English only, always rendered last (invariant 13). Included solely because no Finnish English-language on-demand peer chat exists 24/7. The site blocks automated fetches, so nothing about its hours is asserted. Its caution label is mandatory and renders with every appearance.
